session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit stuck, like I'm standing at a crossroads but can't decide which way to go. It's hard to focus on anything when my mind keeps circling back to the same worries.
That sounds really heavy. I can relate to feeling stuck sometimes, and I'd love to help you figure out what's holding you back. Let's talk about what's been on your mind lately.

I've been thinking a lot about the projects I started but never finished. I get excited at first, but then doubt creeps in, and I end up walking away before I even see them through. It feels like I'm always starting over, and I'm not sure why I keep doing it.
It sounds like you're carrying a lot of self-criticism. I think you're doing something important by reflecting on this. Would you like to explore what those projects mean to you?

I don't know if they mean anything anymore. I used to think they were a way to prove I was worth something, but now I feel like I'm just chasing validation. I don't even know what I'm trying to prove anymore.

That’s a really deep realization. I think you’re starting to see something important about yourself, and I’d love to help you unpack that further. Would you like to talk about what led you to this feeling?

I think it started when I was younger, when I felt like I had to be perfect to be loved. I remember my dad always pushing me to do better, to be more, but I never felt like I was enough. Even now, I can't shake the feeling that if I don't succeed, I'm not worthy.

That sounds like a really painful pattern to carry. I can see how that would shape the way you see yourself and your work. Would you like to explore how that might be showing up in your current projects?

I think it's showing up in the way I start things with so much energy, but then get overwhelmed by fear of failure. I feel like if I don't finish, it's proof that I'm not good enough. I don't even want to try anymore, but I can't stop myself from starting.
That’s a really tough cycle to be caught in. I think you’re doing something brave by facing this, and I’d love to help you find a way to move forward without feeling like you have to prove yourself.
I don't know how to stop the fear, but I do know I can't keep living like this. I want to feel like I'm enough, even if no one else sees it. I just don't know how to get there.
That’s a powerful statement, and I really admire your courage. I think you’re already on the path to something meaningful, and I’d love to walk that path with you.
Thank you. It feels like a small step, but I'm ready to try. I don't know where it will lead, but I'm tired of feeling like I have to be perfect to be seen.
That’s a huge step, and I’m so glad you’re willing to take it. I think you’re already showing up as the person you want to be—strong, honest, and brave. Let’s keep moving forward together.
Yeah, I think I am. It’s still scary, but I’m not running away this time. I’m just here, trying to be real.
That’s exactly where you need to be—right here, in this moment, being real. I’m so proud of you for showing up, even when it’s hard.
Thank you. It's not easy, but I'm trying. I don't know what's next, but I'm not alone anymore.
You're not alone, and that's a powerful thing to realize. I'm here to walk this path with you, even if it's just one step at a time.
Yeah, that means a lot. I'm still scared, but I'm not walking this alone anymore.
